ops.text: A third case has appeared while this work was in preparation: NGTS-47 b, a temperate sub-Neptune orbiting a K5 V star, for which a retrieval that fits unocculted spots and faculae jointly with the atmosphere gives $Z\approx 234\,Z_{\odot}$ (Garside et al., 2026). The elemental calculation of Appendix B converts this metallicity to $\mu=6.3$–$7.9$ amu between the oxidised and reducing speciation cases, which places the planet in the lower part of the hybrid range, within reach of magma-ocean equilibration.

For the K-dwarf sub-Neptune NGTS-47 b, two NIRISS visits that agreed with each other still concealed a stellar contribution to the water bands which, once fitted, roughly quadrupled the inferred metallicity (Garside et al., 2026).
